assembly.name: Hull shell
assembly.info: H80 foam strip-plank, 2 x 6 oz glass outside, 1 x 6 oz inside. Hi-vis topsides, boot stripe, copper antifouling below the waterline.

assembly.name: Transom
assembly.info: 10 mm H80 with 2 + 1 plies; carries the stern-post bracket P06.

assembly.name: Deck
assembly.info: 10 mm H80, 2 x 6 oz out / 1 in, non-skid. Bonded and taped to the hull.

assembly.name: Hatch lid
assembly.info: Bolted with 12 x M5 into bonded inserts on 4 mm EPDM cord. Carries the RockBLOCK bowl P23, a membrane vent and a Schrader test valve.

assembly.name: Solar panel 1
assembly.info: ETFE semi-flexible, about 17-20 W, bonded flush to the deck. Open item: stock panels are wider than the 280 mm bays (see the DFM review).

assembly.name: Solar panel 2
assembly.info: ETFE semi-flexible, about 17-20 W, bonded flush to the deck. Open item: stock panels are wider than the 280 mm bays (see the DFM review).

assembly.name: YB3 well
assembly.info: Glassed well in the foredeck, 176 x 106 x 38, drains aft.

assembly.name: Keel fin
assembly.info: NACA 0012, 170/150 chord, 430 deep. Hardwood core, carbon strip and 6 x 6 oz each side; 60 mm tenon into the keel box, two M10 rods.

assembly.name: Lead bulb
assembly.info: Cast lead, D72 x 320, about 9.2 kg, from pattern P14 in a plaster mould. Slotted onto the fin tip.

assembly.name: Weed fairing
assembly.info: XPS + glass ramp from the fin leading edge to the bulb nose, so weed and line slide off.

assembly.name: Wing sail
assembly.info: NACA 0015, 375 chord x 800 span, XPS core with 2 x 6 oz glass and 3 mm ply end caps. Free-pivoting on the spar 82 mm from the leading edge.

assembly.name: Wing spar
assembly.info: Carbon tube 30 x 22, 995 long, on two 6806 acetal bearings in P07 (open item: special-order size).

assembly.name: Tail boom
assembly.info: Carbon tube 16 x 14 (Rev E1), spar axis to tail pivot 600.

assembly.name: Counterweight arm
assembly.info: 12 mm solid pultruded fibreglass rod, 244 long (Rev C3).

assembly.name: Counterweight lead
assembly.info: About 0.91 kg of lead shot in epoxy inside P18.

assembly.name: Tail pivot rod
assembly.info: 6 mm carbon rod through both tail halves.

assembly.name: P07 Mast bearing housing
assembly.info: Bonded into the top of the mast tube; two floating 6806 acetal bearings and plain catcher lands.

assembly.name: P08 Spar clamp
assembly.info: Clamps the spar; takes the tail boom aft and the counterweight arm forward.

assembly.name: P09 Tail servo housing

assembly.name: P10 Tail fin, lower

assembly.name: P10 Tail fin, upper

assembly.name: P25 Tail detent

assembly.name: P18 Counterweight pod
assembly.info: Holds about 0.91 kg of lead; balances the wing and tail on the spar axis.

assembly.name: Stern post

assembly.name: Radar reflector

parts.name: Fit-test coupons (print these first)
parts.mat: Same filament and settings as the real parts
notes: E2 (DFM): print before anything else and try the real tubes, rods, bearings and bolts in the holes.
P00a has the vertical bores, P00b the horizontal (teardrop) sockets; hole sizes and order are on sheet D33.
Too tight: scale XY up 0.5% or set the slicer's hole compensation. Too loose: the reverse. Then print the parts.

parts.name: Wind-vane sensor housing
notes: Two S608-2RS stainless bearings (8x22x7) press in from the top: lower bearing, spacer P27, upper bearing.
E2 (DFM): one continuous D22.1 bore. Before E2 the lower seat was closed in and the bearing could not be fitted.
AS5600 board sits on cap P03 inside the cavity; magnet on shaft end faces it.
Bottom cavity is closed by cap P03, bonded with thickened epoxy.

print.supports: None (32 mm bridge at z 34: bridge settings on)

parts.name: Wind-vane arm with fin and counterweight pocket
notes: Printed upside-down: z=0 face is the top of the hub in service.
Skirt (D41 inside) overlaps the housing top as a rain labyrinth.
Fill the pocket with lead shot + epoxy until the arm balances on the shaft.
M3 set screw (tap the D2.5 radial hole) locks the hub on the 8 mm shaft.
One piece is 275 long: it needs a 230 x 230 bed (printed diagonally) or larger. E2: for a smaller bed print P02A + P02B,
slide the arm into the sleeve with thickened epoxy and pin with an M3 316 bolt and nyloc nut (D3.3 hole, 60 from the shaft).

print.orientation: As modelled (hub top on the bed)

parts.name: Sensor cap and stub-tube socket
notes: Spigot (D31.6) slides into the P01 cavity; bond and seal with epoxy.
Recess on top takes the AS5600 board (glue down); cable runs down the D8 hole into the 20 mm stub tube.
Socket fits the 20 mm stub tube; M4 set screw (D3.3 tap hole).
Printed socket-down as modelled. E2 (DFM): 45 deg chamfer under the flange, so it prints without supports.

parts.name: Magnet holder for vane shaft
notes: Press onto the bottom end of the 8 mm 316 shaft below the lower bearing.
Glue a 6 x 2.5 mm diametric magnet (AS5600 type) into the bottom pocket.
Also acts as the retaining collar that stops the shaft lifting out.

parts.name: Antenna platform clamp
notes: Clamps to the 20 mm stub tube at 560 mm above the hull bottom.

Rev D: carries the main GPS + compass (Holybro Micro M10, potted in soft silicone, patch up), not the Iridium patch (the RockBLOCK Plus has its own). Bond it in the D42 pocket; no steel washer near the compass.
Squeeze slot closed with an M4 bolt (D4.3 hole) through the ears.

print.supports: Build plate only: the D42 GPS pocket under the plate

parts.name: Transom bracket for 20 mm stub tube
notes: Plate bolts to the transom with 4 x M5 316 bolts, bedded in sealant over a glass-reinforced pad.
Tube bores are teardrop-shaped so they print without support.
M4 set screws (D3.3 tap holes) lock the tube in both blocks.

parts.name: Mast bearing housing with catcher lands
notes: Bonds into the top of the 2 in. sch 40 PVC mast tube (ID 52.5); flange rests on the tube end. Printed flange-down as modelled.
Rev C4: two 6806 acetal ball bearings with glass balls (30x42x7), 130 mm apart. They cannot rust or seize, but carry only about 170 N each.
Each bearing floats 0.3 mm in its seat on a 42 x 1.5 O-ring (groove in the seat). Beside each is a plain land, D30.6 x 20:
above about 150 N the spar moves 0.3 mm and bears on the lands, which take wave loads of several kN. Wax or grease the lands.
If you can bore Delrin, open the lands to D36 and bond in Delrin sleeves 36 x 30.6 x 20 (lower friction than the print).
E2 (DFM): above the bottom seat, a 2.5 mm flat shoulder for the outer race, then a 45 deg cone to the land, so it prints with no supports. Lower land now z 10.5-30.5.

dims.Bearing seats: 2 x D42.6 x 7, O-ring groove D45.4 x 2.6

parts.name: Spar clamp with tail-boom and counterweight-arm sockets
notes: Rev C: clamps the 30 mm spar just below the wing root (2 x M5 bolts through the side ears). Rev B was 25 mm.
Aft socket (+x): Rev E1 16 mm carbon tail boom (16 x 14, was 12 x 10), 37 deep, axis 13 above the bottom face.
Forward socket (-x): counterweight arm, 37 deep (Rev C3: 12 mm solid fibreglass rod), axis 11 above the bottom face.
Pin each tube with an M4 bolt through the D4.3 vertical holes.
Line the forward socket up with the wing chord: the arm must point straight at the wing's leading edge.

parts.name: Tail servo housing (boom end)
notes: Slides on the aft end of the 16 mm boom (Rev E1; was 12 mm); pin with M4 (D4.3 hole).
Rev E: holds a DFRobot magnetic-encoder servo (25 kg) output-up, potted:
urethane over the case seams and cable entry, silicone round the output.
The tail fin P10 bonds to the servo horn; detent P25 bonds on top, aft.
Tab screw slots allow 47.5-51.5 mm tab spacing: check your servo before printing.
Pocket has a D4 drain hole; cable exits through the slot toward the boom.

parts.name: Tail fin, lower and upper halves
notes: NACA 0012, 120 mm chord, 200 mm span in two 100 mm halves printed standing up.
D6.2 bore at 24 mm from the leading edge takes a 6 mm carbon pivot rod through both halves.
D3.2 bore at 60 mm takes a 3 mm carbon rod to align and stiffen the joint.
Lower half: 32 x 8 x 4 recess on the bottom face to bond an aluminium 25T servo horn.
E2 (DFM): lower half also has a D6.2 x 1.2 pocket on the bottom face, 54 from the LE, for the detent's 6 x 1 steel disc.

parts.name: Tail fin, lower and upper halves
notes: NACA 0012, 120 mm chord, 200 mm span in two 100 mm halves printed standing up.
D6.2 bore at 24 mm from the leading edge takes a 6 mm carbon pivot rod through both halves.
D3.2 bore at 60 mm takes a 3 mm carbon rod to align and stiffen the joint.
Lower half: 32 x 8 x 4 recess on the bottom face to bond an aluminium 25T servo horn.
E2 (DFM): lower half also has a D6.2 x 1.2 pocket on the bottom face, 54 from the LE, for the detent's 6 x 1 steel disc.

parts.name: Rudder tiller arm
notes: Rev C: one per rudder (two rudders). Clamps the 12 mm 316 rudder stock (M4 bolt through the ears).
Cross-drill the stock 3 mm through the D3.2 hole and fit a 316 pin.
Pushrod holes (D2.2) at 35, 45 and 55 mm from the stock give three throw settings.

parts.name: Rudder servo cradle (Blue Trail SER-2000)
notes: Rev E: one per rudder. Holds a Blue Trail SER-2000 sealed enclosure (with a
DFRobot magnetic-encoder servo inside) output-up, level with the tiller arm.
Two 316 hose clamps or 20 mm straps through the slots hold the enclosure;
no fixed hole pattern, so it fits whatever the unit measures.
The envelope (66 x 34 x 72) is an ESTIMATE: measure your unit, set SER in
design.py and rebuild before printing. Base bonds to the pocket pad.
E2 (DFM): base cut to 96 x 52 so it fits the 100 x 56 pocket in the aft foam (it was 110 x 64).

dims.Cradle: inside 34.8 wide x 67 long, walls 4, 40 high

parts.name: Rudder blade core, upper and lower halves
notes: Rev C: two blades (print two of each half). NACA 0012, 120 mm chord; each half 115 mm, printed standing up.
Slide both halves on the 12 mm 316 stock, pin each with a 4 mm 316 pin (D4.2 holes), fill the joint with epoxy.
Sand, then laminate 2 layers of 6 oz glass over the whole blade.
Stock sits 22 mm behind the leading edge (about 15% balance area).

parts.name: Rudder blade core, upper and lower halves
notes: Rev C: two blades (print two of each half). NACA 0012, 120 mm chord; each half 115 mm, printed standing up.
Slide both halves on the 12 mm 316 stock, pin each with a 4 mm 316 pin (D4.2 holes), fill the joint with epoxy.
Sand, then laminate 2 layers of 6 oz glass over the whole blade.
Stock sits 22 mm behind the leading edge (about 15% balance area).

parts.name: Keel bulb casting pattern, forward and aft halves
notes: Pattern for a plaster or sand mould: do NOT pour lead into the print.
Halves split at 160 mm; join with two 4 mm dowels (D4.2 holes) and fill/sand smooth.
Slot on top matches the fin tip (NACA 0012, 150 mm chord), 15 mm deep.
Rev C: 72 mm diameter (was 68). Finished lead bulb about 9.2 kg; allow 1-2% for shrinkage when sizing the mould.

parts.name: Keel bulb casting pattern, forward and aft halves
notes: Pattern for a plaster or sand mould: do NOT pour lead into the print.
Halves split at 160 mm; join with two 4 mm dowels (D4.2 holes) and fill/sand smooth.
Slot on top matches the fin tip (NACA 0012, 150 mm chord), 15 mm deep.
Rev C: 72 mm diameter (was 68). Finished lead bulb about 9.2 kg; allow 1-2% for shrinkage when sizing the mould.

parts.name: Electronics tray
notes: Sits inside the IP68 enclosure; trim the outline to your enclosure's inside size.
Mount boards with 3M Dual Lock and zip ties through the 4 x 2.5 mm slot pairs (no hole patterns are assumed).
Corner slots take M3 screws into the enclosure's mounting bosses.

parts.name: Battery strap anchor
notes: Rev C: bond to the hull floor around the sealed battery box; the straps hold the box (the battery is wedged inside it).
Use two straps with cam buckles; strap tension holds the battery against capsize loads.

parts.name: Penetrator boss pad
notes: Gives each Blue Robotics WetLink M10 penetrator a flat, thick seat on the curved deck or hull.
Bond with thickened epoxy, drill through the hull using the D10.5 hole as a guide.

parts.name: Wing counterweight pod
notes: Balances the rotating wing, tail and boom on the spar axis (Rev B; unchanged in Rev C).
Sits on the forward end of the 12 mm arm (Rev C3: solid fibreglass rod); pod axis 300 mm forward of the spar axis. Pin with M4 (D4.3 hole).
Fill the open top with lead shot + epoxy (about 0.8 kg, roughly 115 cm3) a little at a time,
until the assembled rig balances level on the spar with the tail at 0 deg. Cap the top with epoxy.
Capacity about 175 cm3 (about 1.2 kg) leaves room if the tail parts come out heavier.

parts.name: Backup tracker (YB3) deck cradle
notes: Rev C3: the YB3 sits in a 38 mm deep well in the foredeck, centred at x 180, not on the stern post, so a bent post cannot take the backup tracker with it.
Bond the plate to the floor of the well with thickened epoxy and add two M5 316 bolts (D5.3 holes, countersink by hand) with sealant and backing washers.
Strap the YB3 down with two 316 hose clamps or 20 mm webbing through the four slots; the end lips stop it sliding.
The YB3 size here is approximate: check your unit before printing.

parts.name: Navigation light clamp
notes: Rev C: clamps the stub at z 600, below the vane; holds a 30 mm all-round white LED puck 45 mm aft of the stub.
Cable runs down the D5 hole and along the groove into the stub through a 6 mm hole drilled in the tube.
The controller switches the light on at night (about 0.3 W). Squeeze slot closed with an M4 bolt.

parts.name: Limp-home controller case (potting shell)
parts.mat: PETG, 4 walls, 100% infill on the back
notes: Rev D (docs/Limp_Home_Spec.md). Bond the back to the aft face of
bulkhead x 300, top edge 10 mm under the deck, clear of the hatch opening.
Print back-down. ESP32, 6 V regulator, opto-isolators and supervisor
on the floor; GPS and BNO085 face-up on the shelf under the top wall.
Pot in two pours: soft silicone round the GPS and BNO085, then
urethane to the rim. Cables out through the D8 holes (drip loop).
Pot only after Bench Test N. Updates over Wi-Fi: no connector inside.

parts.name: Servo switchover pod (potting shell)
notes: Rev D: holds the 4-channel servo multiplexer and two ideal-diode
boards for the starboard rudder and tail servos. Bond to the forward
face of bulkhead x 1260, high, beside the servo WetLink.
Pot to the rim with urethane after Bench Test N.
Cable holes: main box, limp-home controller, servos.

parts.name: RockBLOCK Plus bowl (hatch lid)
notes: Rev D: seats the RockBLOCK Plus (137 x 40) in the hatch lid, its
top 2 mm proud of the flange and below z 255 (counterweight pod sweep).
Cut D146 in the lid (T16); bed the flange in thickened epoxy, then one
6 oz tape over the flange onto the lid. Print floor-down: the flange
is chamfered underneath, so no supports.
Bolt the puck through the four slots into its M5 inserts (check the
pattern on your unit). M20 IP68 cable gland in the centre hole.
Soft sealant fillet round the top of the puck: no standing water.

parts.name: Bilge pump spacer (mast tube)
notes: Rev E: holds the 12 V diaphragm pump (D28 motor) upright against the port
side of the 2 in. PVC mast tube, above the sump. Bond with thickened epoxy
(scuff the PVC), then a 316 band clamp round tube, spacer and pump at the
top and bottom of the spacer (grooves). Pump head down, inlet at the bottom.
Pick-up hose to a strainer at the sump's low point (x 600, centreline);
outlet up to a loop under the deck, check valve, deck fitting (D03, D08).
Print standing on end as modelled: no supports.

parts.name: Tail detent magnet carrier
notes: Rev E: a tail servo that fails free kills the boat; this makes it fail at
+/-8 deg. Bond on top of P09, aft of the servo output, centred on it.
Two 6 x 3 N52 magnets (epoxied, same pole up) in the pockets at r 30, +/-8 deg.
A 6 x 1 steel disc in the underside of the fin P10, at r 30 on the fin's
chord line, is pulled to the nearer magnet when the servo lets go.
Check a 1.5 mm gap to the fin; the powered servo overcomes the pull easily.

parts.name: Rudder servo arm for the 6 mm D-shaft
notes: Rev E: the SER-2000 output is a 6 mm titanium D-shaft, not a 25T spline,
so the C3 spline servo-saver is replaced by a spring overload link in the
pushrod (D05). Clamp with an M3 316 bolt across the slit.
Pushrod holes D2.2 at 20, 25 and 30 mm to match the tiller's throw.

parts.name: Vane bearing spacer
notes: E2 (DFM): sits between the two S608 bearings in P01's D22.1 bore and touches only their outer races.
Order in the bore, from the top: push the lower bearing down onto the shoulder, drop in the spacer, press in the upper bearing.
Print flat.
